blocks._note: The sheet says WHICH state each sport is in; this says what that state SOUNDS like. Two sports across four states is sixteen combinations, so the sentence is composed from fragments rather than written out. The form sits below it in every state — Google Forms is the authority on whether it will take an answer, and says so more precisely than this file could: a form scheduled to open announces the date and time itself. The closing line is the same in every state and says nothing about the form, so it cannot contradict the sentence above it. The address of the form is the sheet’s "Registration Form" cell, not a line in this file, so an officer replacing the form for a new season changes it in one place and nothing here moves — whatever they paste is reduced to the form’s own id and rebuilt, because the address Google shows in the browser bar depends on whether the form happens to be open. The full mapping is documented in docs/content-sync-spec.md §5.6.
